goals.reason: Both cases require explanation of physical enrichment by volatility with unchanged molecular identities. The first provided oil-column model asks own height assignment, causal evaporation/condensation explanation and rejection of molecule creation. The second transfers to two isomers with supplied normal boiling data and a missing-light-component feed. Same carbon count is deliberately insufficient; purity is not claimed. This is independent model reasoning rather than copied refinery labels.

providedHelp: Supplied three boiling ranges and uses
independentPerformance: Assign draw-off heights from boiling behaviour
Justify unchanged molecules; reject production of new short chains
caseAssessments.limit: Reciting already supplied uses or copying the parent overview is assisted and insufficient. No sharp pure-product claim, apparatus construction or real experiment follows.

providedHelp: Isomer names and common molecular formula C8H18
Feed lacks the stipulated light range
independentPerformance: Infer higher enrichment from lower boiling behaviour despite same molecular formula
Reject creation of missing feed molecules by separation alone
Explain model limitation without assuming completely pure fractions
caseAssessments.limit: Given normal boiling points are model data, not recall; same pressure and an appropriate column are implicit in the supplied normal-boiling comparison. No VLE/yield calculation is required.

goals.reason: Both cases distinguish chemical creation of new molecule identities from sorting and ask conservation reasoning. Correct C10/C12 model combinations conserve C and H; the incorrect sole-input C12 proposal has two excess H atoms and requires additional material. A given equation is assistance rather than uncued equation formulation. Thermal energy input is not incorrectly universalized into every reaction enthalpy.

independentPerformance: Explain changed molecules by bond rearrangement at high temperature
Check total10C and22H and reject pure boiling-point sorting
caseAssessments.limit: Equation copying cannot count as independent equation formulation. Supplied one-pair model is not the unique or complete industrial mixture.

providedHelp: C12H26 input and both proposed formula/structure combinations
Several pathways in an actual cracker
independentPerformance: Identify two excess H atoms in B and require extraH source rather than creating atoms
Classify supplied butene by double bond
caseAssessments.limit: For the explicitly sole-input simplified split B is impossible; hydrogen transfer from other inputs/pathways would be an additional material source and is not silently ruled out for real mixtures. No radical mechanism, plant design or yield computation.

bilingualAssessment: Full DE/EN expectations, cases, supplied facts and claim limits agree. Thermal/physical distinction, provided-help conditions and freshness are retained in both languages.
assistanceBoundary: Any generated child illustration or kept parent overview that shows correct positions/molecules is prior assistance. A displayed diagram or supplied equation cannot itself be counted as independently produced performance; require the fresh causal explanation and altered-case reasoning specified by the profiles.
independentCurricularReviewScope: Exactly these two child profiles, after the separate frozen D/source verdict. No review or reapproval of historical profiles for other Chemistry goals.
